mapper.select: select TT.booksetId, TT.subjectNo, TT.balanceDate, TT.balFlag, sum(oAmt) as oAmt, sum(oDAmt) as oDAmt, sum(oCAmt) as oCAmt from ( select bb.bookset_id as booksetId, SUBSTRING(bb.subject_no,1,4) as subjectNo, bb.balance_date as balanceDate, bb.bal_flag as balFlag, IFNULL(bb.o_amt, 0) as oAmt, IFNULL(bb.o_d_amt, 0) as oDAmt, IFNULL(bb.o_c_amt, 0) as oCAmt from BOK_BALANCE bb INNER JOIN REP_PROD_INFO RP ON BB.BOOKSET_ID=RP.F_PROD_ID where RP.PROD_ID = #{booksetId} and bb.balance_date = #{balanceDate} ) TT GROUP BY TT.booksetId,TT.subjectNo,TT.balanceDate,TT.balFlag
